name: dual_wield
verifies: fix-32: G3 dual wielding — with Perk_1H1H_1 a second one-handed weapon goes to the off-hand slot (inventory equip and quick slot), the draw takes both blades (Hold_Begin), the off-hand key puts the left blade away and takes it again (HoldLeft_End/_Begin), the left and right combos and the quick chain run in the 1H_1H set, both blades hit, the sheathe puts both away
notes: Run with combatlog on: the draw/sheathe motion is Hero_Stand_1H_1H_P0_Hold_Begin/_End, the moves Hero_Stand_1H_1H_P*_…, the quick-slot lines say DrawBoth / PutAwayLeft / DrawLeft, and CombatPresenter.logHits (inspector) shows 'Right blade' / 'Left blade' per hit (Attack and PowerAttack: both blades, QuickAttack/Pierce: left from P1). fix-38: the hold fires PowerAttack after 100 ms and releasing it 0.2-0.5 s into the power state combos into SimpleWhirl with a 1H blade in the left hand (CP combat_moves.json, MeleeInputInterpreter.ComboOnRelease); r27 held 0.6 s = 0.5 s state time, on the edge, and got the correct SimpleWhirl. Now: hold 1.0 s stays PowerAttack, hold 0.4 s is the SimpleWhirl. Needs the 1H_1H motions in the hero library (re-import the hero motions after fix-32).
